title: Piece on Utopia
description: This project challenges the rigid physical boundaries of traditional urbanism by proposing a reconfigurable city prototype. Born from the need for social safety and resource balance in a post-pandemic world, the design deconstructs urban functions—housing, healthcare, and commerce—into autonomous, mobile modules. By utilizing vertical transport towers and a circular rail system, these "pieces" can be assembled or relocated in real-time. This shifts the urban paradigm from "people seeking services" to "services finding people," creating a resilient utopia capable of adapting to public health crises while maintaining vibrant social connectivity.
